title.narrative: Grant to the Ministry of Trade and Industry for the Implementation of the Stepping Stone Economic Partnership Agreement and Accompanying Measures

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project of which this contract will be a part is, in the context of the Ghana beyond aid vision, to improve economic governance and business environment and to maximise the benefits of the EPA for Ghana. The results to be achieved are comprised as follows:a)Strong and proactive national ownership of and management of the EPA b)Institutional strengthening and human resources capacity building of MoTI and other stakeholdersc)Passage of enabling trade rules, legislation and technical regulations supporting investment and the development of socially responsible enterprises in Ghana
